senses.gloss: m. (<cite ref="A02060"><he>אמר</he></cite>, √<he>אם</he>, v. <cite ref="A02037"><he>אמם</he></cite>; cmp. <he>עמרא</he>, <cite ref="H00395"><he>חומרא</he></cite>, <cite ref="R00593"><he>צמר</he></cite>)

units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 30:32">Targ. Gen. XXX, 32</cite>; a. fr.—

Ned. I, 3 ‘this be as forbidden to me כאימרא (Y. ib. I, end, 37ᵃ כאימרה) as the lamb’—כאימר תמידא that means, ‘as the lamb of the daily offering’. Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh. 2) דהוה נכיס אמ׳ וכ׳ who slaughters a lamb and augurs from its liver.

Erub. 53ᵇ (deriding the Galilean dialect) a Galilean cried אמר למאן וכ׳ who wants amar? (indistinctly pronouncing the vowels, as well as the guttural sound of א), when they said to him …, חמר למירכב או חמר למשתי עמר למילבש או אימר לאיתכסאה (for var. lect., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10) do you mean ḥǎmâr (an ass) to ride on, or ḥămar (wine) to drink, or ãmar (wool) for putting on, or immar (lamb) for slaughtering?; a. fr.—Pl. אִימְּרִין, אִימְּרַיָּא, אִימְּרַיָּיה, אִמְּ׳.

<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 29:38">Targ. Ex. XXIX, 38</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 12:5">XII, 5</cite>; a. e.—Y. Snh. I, 18ᵈ top <he>אי׳ רכיכין</he> the lambs (of the spring) are yet tender (in a letter announcing the intercalation of a month); Bab.
Tosef. ib. II, 6); a. e.—Fem. אִימַּרְתָּא ewe.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 5:6">Targ. Lev. V, 6</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44:23">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> end, the sow (Rome) pastures with twenty (young ones), <he>וא׳ ולא בחד</he> and the ewe (Sarah) not even with one.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 98a:2">Snh. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>כולהו שרי ואסרי אי׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. (in ed. a. Ms. our w. omitted) all of them untie their bandages all at once and tie them up all at once, but he attends to one at a time.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 133:2">Targ. Ps. CXXXIII, 2</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 26:4">Targ. Y. Ex. XXVI, 4</cite> (Var. <he>אֶימְרָא</he>). V. <cite ref="A01351">next w.</cite>
